narrationTexts: Confirms the bug in `orderTotal`: it taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one.
finalText:
**Suite is green: 625 passing, 0 failing.**

`orderTotal` taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one, in [pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41). Spec says tax applies after the discount.

Fixed to tax `discounted` instead of `cents`. No further action needed.
